hero.title: Lord Mahavira: The 24th Tirthankara
hero.description: An analytical study of the life, teachings, and historical impact of Vardhamana Mahavira, the architect of Jain philosophy.

timeline.title: The Chronological Framework
timeline.description: Key life events of Mahavira within the 6th Century BCE Sramana movement.

cards.details: Birth of Vardhamana at Kundagrama near Vaishali to King Siddhartha and Queen Trishala.
Renounced worldly life (Renunciation) after his parents' death to seek truth.
Attained 'Kevala Jnana' (Omniscience) at Jrimbhikagrama under a Sal tree.
Attained 'Nirvana' at Pava (near modern Rajgir) at the age of 72.

items.title: K.V.K.P
items.decryption: Birth location (Kundagrama), Clan/Region (Vaishali/Vrijji), Enlightenment (Kaivalya), and Death (Pava).

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Do not confuse Mahavira as the founder of Jainism; he was the 24th Tirthankara (Restorer).
Mahavira is often incorrectly associated with the same period as Buddha's Nirvana; remember their lifespans overlapped but were distinct.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Birth: Kundagrama (Vaishali)
  • Enlightenment: Jrimbhikagrama
  • Nirvana: Pava (Magadha)

Personalities

  • Parents: Siddhartha (Jnatrika clan), Trishala (Lichchhavi Princess)
  • Wife: Yashoda
  • Daughter: Priyadarshana
  • Life Stages:
    • Early life: Prince of the Jnatrika Kshatriya clan.
    • Renunciation: Left at 30, wandering ascetic for 12 years.
    • Kaivalya: The state of 'Jina' (conqueror of senses).
